This lamp is ok, it’s a tad smaller than I would like. And when you put your hand in you have to have to have your hand in just the right spot for the light to come on. I do my own poly gel and gel nail polish and about half way through I was so flustered by this lamp I got out my old one. It comes with gloves and says it was to come with nail files but I didn’t receive them. Overall this is just ok for a beginner it’s probably fine but for someone more experienced I’d say pass.

I bought this with the understanding from the reviews that this was awesome and with no issues cure gel polish and regular polish. It may cure both but I wasn't willing to try past a minute to cure. If I have to do it longer than that. it isn't worth it. I just went ahead and bought a gel kit that already had one I've used in the past. Save your money. This isn't worth the hassle of a return.

The shipping was fast. The product looks beautiful. BUT this product has the biggest disadvantage when you put thumb inside the light doesn’t turn on. I have to put something inside, I put paint brush next to thumb. I lose a lot of time to make the nails done  with this. I am very disappointed because I like how this lamp look likes.

I liked the fact that it has three LED timer settings (30, 60, and 99 seconds). I colored my nails with ASP Gel polish using the 30 sec timer and it worked perfectly. The chamber size is wide enough for the whole hand (but not bulky). A sensor activates the timer when the hand is placed inside. The heat emitted is low compared to other similar devices that I‘ve owned.  In general, it is a good product for at-home manicures.

reviews.t: Recommended by friend, meets/exceeds my expectations
reviews.x: I wanted to be able to have gel manicures more often without having to go to a salon. I wanted to save time and money by being able to do this at home. The directions given on Amazon were easy enough to follow and my questions were answers by the Amazon community when I wasn't 100% sure about the steps (when to rub nails with alcohol). Works well with Gelish brand polish.

I bought this for my wife and this product really exceeded all expectations; very stylish and easy to use immediately out of the box.  the machine features an automatic on/off, which is super convenient when you're doing your nails and don't want to accidentally smudge your work. the light is powerful and bright.

I have been spending money on professional mani/pedis for years, but this dryer lets me do it by myself! This is easy to use and it dries my nails quickly. I really like that once it's plugged in and the time set, it activates when you put your hand or toes in. It's like I said, it's easy to use!
I need touch up here and there before having time to go to the nail salon. This product works great for what I need. I really like it and the price is good too. I would recommend to others.
This lamp is a very good product. Opens on both sides timers are easy to press and it came with gloves to protect your hands which are so important for me.

reviews.t: UV LED Nail Lamp Dryer 54W Curing Nail Lamp Nail Light for Gel Polish
reviews.x: Gel nails-they don't chip, break or fail in any way.  For those of us who type regularly, we love nail polish that doesn't wear off at the tips in a few days.  If you are a gel nail lover, this is a great kit to get.  This is my second gel nail kit.  This kit has the light with a LCD screen, a timer and an infrared sensor.  This also has a nail file with it, and  I love the fact that this kit includes a pair of gloves.  By the way, this type of light is the type of light used in tanning beds, an

I love the fact that this little lamp works as good as the nail salon ones. The only thing that bothers me a bit is that when doing my polygel nails with the dual tips, the tips are too long and won't allow me to rest my hands fully down because the tips will pop off, so the lamp wont detect my hand unless I put my other hands finger in. Other than that, the lamp works wonderfully.

Bought as a Christmas gift for my sister in law who loves doing her own acrylics. Came beautifully packaged with nail files, fingerless gloves to protect hands from UV light damage and of course the light itself. Best value for money UV light on Amazon in my opinion. She loves it too, says it works brilliantly to dry her acrylic and polish.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lamp as easy to use and effective at quickly drying or curing gel polish.
Many reviewers consider it a great value for the affordable price.
Several reviewers note the sensor can be finicky, requiring the hand to be positioned just right for the light to activate.
Some reviewers mention the lamp is smaller than expected or not strong enough to cure polish in a reasonable time.
Reviewers appreciate the included UV-protective gloves and the wide chamber that fits a full hand or foot.
